OpenDocument Text — 201 .NET tests passing, needs new APIs and governed transcripts
PBM/PGM/PPM family — 120 .NET tests, multi-format, good for breadth

cross_stream_requirements.skills_requirement: declare governed_execution_consumed=true after Skills produces governed transcripts
cross_stream_requirements.acceleration_requirement: declare reusable_accelerator_consumed=true after Acceleration produces ai_draft outputs

stop_conditions: Do NOT target fewer than 3 format families (blocks CLEAN_PASS)
Do NOT declare CLEAN_PASS without source_diffs≥3
Do NOT declare governed_execution_consumed=true unless Skills actually produced governed transcripts
Do NOT claim reusable_accelerator_consumed=true unless Acceleration produced ai_draft outputs
Do NOT push or commit without explicit user authorization
Do NOT approve Gate 8 or Gate 11
